sentences.zh: 如果你只是站在那里，和蔼、直觉敏锐且自信地问大家，你们会怎么拍

sentences.en: You're fine.

sentences.zh: 而电影或限定剧，本质上就像一部长电影，你必须

sentences.zh: 它是那种超级冷幽默的吗？

sentences.zh: 你得确立所有这些东西，但在一部正在播出的剧里，感觉就像是，

sentences.en: I look, I took it super seriously because it's an amazing first step, but it's not nearly

sentences.en: as hard, you know, coming into an ongoing show.
sentences.zh: 那么难，你知道，中途加入一部正在播出的剧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: The advice I got from Randall Einhorn, our longtime director of photography and later our most,
sentences.zh: 我从兰德尔·艾因霍恩那里得到的建议，他是我们长期的摄影指导，后来成了我们

sentences.en: um, prolific director on the show.
sentences.zh: 呃，剧组里作品最多的导演。

sentences.en: I said, do you have advice?
sentences.zh: 我问他，你有什么建议吗？

sentences.en: He said, yes, direct the cameras like they're actors.
sentences.zh: 他说，有，像对待演员一样去执导摄影机。

sentences.en: I said, what do you mean?
sentences.zh: 我说，什么意思？

sentences.en: He said, you'd never tell an actor, shout this line and cut it off after three seconds.
sentences.zh: 他说，你绝不会告诉演员，在这句台词大喊出来，然后在三秒后切掉。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You tell them why.
sentences.zh: 你会告诉他们原因。

sentences.en: So you never tell the camera swing to the left on this line and punch in on that.
sentences.zh: 所以你永远不要告诉摄影师在这句台词时向左摇镜头，然后推近。

sentences.en: You'd say, this is where we catch Pam and her lie.
sentences.zh: 你会说，这是我们要捕捉帕姆和她谎言的地方。

sentences.en: So I would creep up to her and find that moment and don't let her out.
sentences.zh: 所以我会慢慢靠近她，捕捉到那一刻，不要让她跑出镜头。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你明白我的意思吗？

sentences.en: And it, it inspires so much more creativity.
sentences.zh: 这激发了多得多的创造力。

sentences.en: It's so much more respectful and you're more likely to get what you're looking for.
sentences.zh: 这更尊重他人，你也更有可能得到你想要的效果。

sentences.en: And, you know, I've extended that to direct to everyone like their actors.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我把这一点延伸到了所有人身上，像对待演员一样去执导每个人。

sentences.en: You don't tell the costume department, I want him in a suit.
sentences.zh: 你不会告诉服装部门，我要他穿西装。

sentences.en: You say, this is a character who's so insecure that he takes himself.
sentences.zh: 你会说，这个角色非常自卑，他把自己看得……

sentences.en: He tries to tell the world he's important.
sentences.zh: 他试图告诉全世界他很重要。

sentences.en: I want him in a suit.
sentences.zh: 我要他穿西装。

sentences.en: Every day he'll wear a suit.
sentences.zh: 他每天都要穿西装。

sentences.en: Now the costume designer is so excited, you know, rather than, oh, she went to Sears and
sentences.zh: 现在服装设计师就非常兴奋了，你知道，而不是说，哦，她去西尔斯百货

sentences.en: got a suit.
sentences.zh: 买了一套西装。

sentences.en: And then you say, make it look fancier.
sentences.zh: 然后你再说，让它看起来更高级点。

sentences.en: No one understands what you're doing.
sentences.zh: 没人明白你在做什么。

sentences.en: No one's motivated.
sentences.zh: 没人有动力。

sentences.en: Whereas actors, that's how you talk to an actor, right?
sentences.zh: 而演员，你就是这样和演员沟通的，对吧？

sentences.en: And people know that much more.
sentences.zh: 而且人们对此了解得更多。

sentences.en: So direct everyone like they're actors is I think the best advice I got on that show.
sentences.zh: 所以像对待演员一样去执导每个人，我认为是我在那部剧里得到的最好的建议。

sentences.en: Other advice I got later, the other two great pieces of advice, a friend, Lee Whannell, who
sentences.zh: 我后来得到的其他建议，另外两条很棒的建议，来自一位朋友，雷·沃纳尔，他

sentences.en: just wrote and directed Invisible Man, which I thought was great.
sentences.zh: 刚刚编剧并执导了《隐形人》，我觉得那部片子很棒。

sentences.en: And he had been a writer forever.
sentences.zh: 而且他做了很久的编剧。

sentences.en: And he said that he actually took a panel on directing at the Writers Guild of America.
sentences.zh: 他说他实际上参加了美国编剧工会举办的一个导演座谈会。

sentences.en: And he's like, BJ, I won't do his Australian accent.
sentences.zh: 他当时说，BJ，我可不会模仿他的澳大利亚口音。

sentences.en: He's like, it's the kind of thing you get junk mail for.
sentences.zh: 他说，那种东西你平时只会当垃圾邮件处理。

sentences.en: Come to this seminar, blah, blah, blah.
sentences.zh: 什么来参加这个研讨会，巴拉巴拉之类的。

sentences.en: It was the best thing I've ever been to in my life.
sentences.zh: 结果那是我这辈子参加过最棒的活动。

sentences.en: It was like John Wells.
sentences.zh: 有约翰·威尔斯在场。

sentences.en: It was Catherine Bigelow.
sentences.zh: 还有凯瑟琳·毕格罗。

sentences.en: And they were giving practical advice and cynical advice and inspiring advice.
sentences.zh: 他们给出了实用的建议、愤世嫉俗的建议，还有鼓舞人心的建议。

sentences.en: And he was like, it was the best thing I've ever been to.
sentences.zh: 他说，那真是他参加过最棒的活动。

sentences.en: And everything I tell you is going to be from that.
sentences.zh: 我接下来要告诉你们的一切，都源自那里。

sentences.en: This advice was the best thing you can do as a director is watch the movie in your head
sentences.zh: 那个建议是，作为导演你能做的最棒的事，就是在脑海里构思整部电影，

sentences.en: as much as you can.
sentences.zh: 尽可能多地去构思。

sentences.en: Whenever you're in doubt, just take a walk and watch the whole movie in your head.
sentences.zh: 每当你感到困惑时，就去散散步，在脑海里把整部电影过一遍。

sentences.en: And then when you're in a production meeting and someone says, what does the room look
sentences.zh: 然后当你在制作会议上，有人问你，房间看起来

sentences.en: like?
sentences.zh: 是什么样子的？

sentences.en: You just say what you see and they figure it out.
sentences.zh: 你只需要说出你看到的，他们自然会去实现。

sentences.en: You don't need to know what the lens is and what the lighting scheme is.
sentences.zh: 你不需要知道该用什么镜头，也不需要知道灯光方案是什么。

sentences.en: If someone says, you know, what are they wearing or how do you want to shoot this?
sentences.zh: 如果有人问，你知道的，他们穿什么，或者你想怎么拍这一场？

sentences.en: You know, you can say, oh, I picture closeups or I picture, oh, you're like looking from
sentences.zh: 你可以说，哦，我想象的是特写，或者我想象的是，哦，就像是从

sentences.en: a distance.
sentences.zh: 远处看过去一样。

sentences.en: You know, it will have the same effect as if you studied everything in school because the
sentences.zh: 你知道，这会产生和你去学校系统学习一样的效果，因为

sentences.en: point is to know the heart.
sentences.zh: 关键在于要把握核心。

sentences.en: So watch the movie in your head.
sentences.zh: 所以，在脑海里构思你的电影吧。

sentences.en: But the other piece of advice that's so simple, this was, I have a friend whose father is Al
sentences.zh: 但还有另一个建议非常简单，这是，我有个朋友，他父亲是艾尔·拉迪，

sentences.en: Ruddy who produced The Godfather.
sentences.zh: 也就是《教父》的制片人。

sentences.en: And I asked him if he had any advice on directing.
sentences.zh: 我问他有没有什么导演方面的建议。

sentences.en: He said, you only need to know two things to direct, what you want and how to get it.
sentences.zh: 他说，做导演只需要知道两件事：你想要什么，以及如何得到它。

sentences.en: And I was like, you know what?
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I think that's the best advice I've gotten for anything because those are two very hard
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是我听过关于任何事情最好的建议，因为这两件事

sentences.en: things.
sentences.zh: 都非常难做到。

sentences.en: In a way, knowing what you want is even harder, but all of us can approach, okay, if you know
sentences.zh: 某种程度上，知道自己想要什么更难，但我们所有人都可以尝试，好吧，如果你知道

sentences.en: what you want and how to get it, you'll accomplish anything.
sentences.zh: 你想要什么以及如何得到它，你就能成就任何事。

sentences.en: And we do that for all sorts of things.
sentences.zh: 我们在处理各种事情时都是这样做的。

sentences.en: And how to get it includes asking someone for help or to understand something or to explain
sentences.zh: 而“如何得到它”包括向别人寻求帮助，或者去理解某事，或者去解释

sentences.en: something or to beg them for a favor, you know, or to, you know, grind them down because
sentences.zh: 某事，或者去求他们帮个忙，你知道，或者，你知道，磨到他们同意，因为

sentences.en: they're just not getting it and whatever it is or inspiring them or whatever you need to
sentences.zh: 他们就是不明白，不管是什么情况，或者激励他们，或者任何你需要做的事，

sentences.en: get it.
sentences.zh: 去得到它。

sentences.en: So that's, you know, what you want and how to get it.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，就是“你想要什么”和“如何得到它”。

sentences.en: And then I told them, I ran into him and I was like, you gave me the best advice ever.
sentences.zh: 后来我告诉他，我偶遇了他，我说，你给了我史上最好的建议。

sentences.en: And I quoted it to him.
sentences.zh: 我把那句话复述给他听。

sentences.en: And he's like, oh, there's a third part.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，其实还有第三部分。

sentences.en: I forgot to tell you.
sentences.zh: 我忘了告诉你了。

sentences.en: You got to know when you got it.
sentences.zh: 你还得知道你什么时候已经得到了它。

sentences.en: I was like, I don't like that one.
sentences.zh: 我说，我不喜欢这一条。

sentences.en: I'm editing that one out.
sentences.zh: 我要把它删掉。

sentences.en: You're not wrong.
sentences.zh: 你没说错。

sentences.en: You're not wrong, but it's not as good a quote.
sentences.zh: 你没说错，但这句名言没那么精彩了。

sentences.en: And I said that to him.
sentences.zh: 我当时就是这么对他说的。

sentences.en: He's like, no, no, I don't know what.
sentences.zh: 他说，不，不，我不知道怎么说。

sentences.en: I think he just worked on a movie with some director.
sentences.zh: 我想他刚和某位导演合作完一部电影。

sentences.en: It took forever.
sentences.zh: 这花了好久好久。

sentences.en: I was like, Al, no, this is not, this is Godfather part three.
sentences.zh: 当时我就说，艾尔，不行，这不对，这简直是《教父3》。

sentences.en: This is not as good.
sentences.zh: 这可没那么好。

sentences.en: So I just quote the first two parts.
sentences.zh: 所以我只引用前两部。

sentences.en: That's so true, BJ.
sentences.zh: 说得太对了，BJ。

sentences.en: I know, you know, Angela and I changed our whole lives because we wanted to get something.
sentences.zh: 你是知道的，安吉拉和我改变了我们整个人生，因为我们想要得到某种东西。

sentences.en: We wanted to get a quality of life.
sentences.zh: 我们想要获得一种生活质量。

sentences.en: We wanted to be able to make it to soccer practice.
sentences.zh: 我们想要能够赶上足球训练。

sentences.en: We want to take our kids to school.
sentences.zh: 我们想送孩子们去上学。

sentences.en: I didn't know you play soccer.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你还踢足球。

sentences.en: Seriously.
sentences.zh: 认真的。

sentences.en: I'm sweeper, BJ.
sentences.zh: 我是清道夫，BJ。

sentences.en: Nothing's getting into the goal.
sentences.zh: 任何球都别想进门。

sentences.en: No, we just wanted to make our families firSt.
sentences.zh: 不，我们只是想把家庭放在第一位。

sentences.en: And yeah, just have agency over our own schedules and our time and pour that into our family as a priority.
sentences.zh: 没错，就是想对自己日程和时间有掌控权，并把这些投入到家庭中，作为首要任务。

sentences.en: And we didn't know how to get it.
sentences.zh: 但我们当时不知道该怎么实现。

sentences.en: That took a long time.
sentences.zh: 那花了好长时间。

sentences.en: It took a lot of experimenting.
sentences.zh: 经过了大量的尝试。

sentences.en: Years of kind of griping to each other.
sentences.zh: 多年来我们一直在互相抱怨。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: But then eventually we did it.
sentences.zh: 但最终我们做到了。

sentences.en: And here we are interviewing you on our podcast, which is the result of our wanting to get something.
sentences.zh: 现在我们在这里采访你，这档播客就是我们想要实现目标的成果。

sentences.en: And we didn't know how to do it.
sentences.zh: 而我们当时根本不知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: No, as you were talking.
sentences.zh: 不，就在你刚才说的时候。

sentences.en: But it's so much easier to figure out how to do it.
sentences.zh: 但弄清楚怎么做要容易得多。

sentences.en: Like the worst person to work with is someone who doesn't know what they want.
sentences.zh: 比如，最难合作的人就是那种不知道自己想要什么的人。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: What a nightmare.
sentences.zh: 简直是噩梦。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Nightmare.
sentences.zh: 噩梦。

sentences.en: You knew what you wanted.
sentences.zh: 你当时知道自己想要什么。

sentences.en: So now you're like, I have no idea how to get this.
sentences.zh: 所以现在你只是在想，我不知道该怎么得到它。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: But like you figure that out.
sentences.zh: 但你会想出办法的。

sentences.en: But you're right.
sentences.zh: 但你说得对。

sentences.en: I've worked with directors who don't know what they want, and it really puts everybody through the ringer.
sentences.zh: 我曾和不知道自己想要什么的导演合作过，那真的让每个人都备受折磨。

sentences.en: You know, you're changing clothes a million times, and you're doing the role different ways.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你要换一百万次衣服，还要用不同的方式去演那个角色。

sentences.en: And everyone, it really runs people into the ground.
sentences.zh: 每个人，真的会被折腾得精疲力竭。

sentences.en: But someone with a very clear vision, then you're on set and you're like, okay, well, how do we do it?
sentences.zh: 但如果是一个愿景非常清晰的人，你在片场就会想，好吧，我们该怎么做？

sentences.en: How do we make this happen?
sentences.zh: 我们该怎么实现它？

sentences.en: Like, just give me something that I can hang on to.
sentences.zh: 就像是，只要给我一个我可以抓住的重点就行。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If your vision is clear, we'll get there.
sentences.zh: 如果你的愿景清晰，我们就能达成目标。

sentences.en: Um, oh, I have one other very cynical piece of directing advice, and it does not make the top three, but it really worked.
sentences.zh: 嗯，噢，我还有一个非常愤世嫉俗的导演建议，它没进前三名，但真的很有用。

sentences.en: And someone said to me who had worked on The Office, said, here's my advice.
sentences.zh: 有个在《办公室》工作过的人对我说，这是我的建议。

sentences.en: Pick one shot that's a special shot.
sentences.zh: 选一个镜头作为特别镜头。

sentences.en: It doesn't have to make sense.
sentences.zh: 它不需要有逻辑。

sentences.en: It just like, it stands out.
sentences.zh: 它只需要脱颖而出。

sentences.en: It doesn't quite fit.
sentences.zh: 它甚至可以显得有点格格不入。

sentences.en: And the network will tell you, you're a great director, because they'll notice it and they'll feel proud.
sentences.zh: 然后电视网就会说你是个伟大的导演，因为他们会注意到它，并为此感到自豪。

sentences.en: And I did that.
sentences.zh: 我确实那么做了。

sentences.en: I think it was maybe in the web episode.
sentences.zh: 我觉得可能是在网络剧集里。

sentences.en: No, I think it was in this.
sentences.zh: 不，我觉得是在这一集里。

sentences.en: There's a shot where Creed is like standing by the doorway and waiting to go into the room.
sentences.zh: 有个镜头是克里德站在门口，等着进房间。

sentences.en: I don't know which episode it was in.
sentences.zh: 我不记得是哪一集了。

sentences.en: But literally, the network is that called me personally.
sentences.zh: 但电视台的人真的亲自给我打了电话。

sentences.en: It's like, BJ, you are a great director.
sentences.zh: 他们说，BJ，你是个很棒的导演。

sentences.en: And it was that shot.
sentences.zh: 指的就是那个镜头。

sentences.en: And it was like, it was a stretch that the, I mean, it didn't break The Office style.
sentences.zh: 这有点勉强，我的意思是，它并没有打破《办公室》的风格。

sentences.en: But that is a cynical thing.
sentences.zh: 但那确实是一种愤世嫉俗的做法。

sentences.en: And definitely when you see, like, I've joked, the easiest way to win an Oscar is to be a cinematographer and decide to shoot the movie in glorious black and white.
sentences.zh: 当你看到的时候，就像我开玩笑说的那样，赢得奥斯卡最简单的方法就是当一名摄影师，然后决定用华丽的黑白画面来拍摄电影。

sentences.en: Like, anything that calls attention to yourself as a director is so rewarded.
sentences.zh: 任何能让你作为导演引起注意的东西都会得到极大的褒奖。

sentences.en: So that is my cynical advice.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我那愤世嫉俗的建议。

sentences.en: If you do want to, if you're, if you have the chance to direct something and you want people to think you're good, do something visually unusual,
sentences.zh: 如果你确实想，如果你有机会执导某部作品，并且想让人们觉得你很厉害，那就做一些视觉上不寻常的事情，

sentences.en: which will flatter the intelligence.
sentences.zh: 这会显得你很有智慧。

sentences.en: Do one odd thing.
sentences.zh: 做一件奇怪的事。

sentences.en: And every critic and every person will say, ooh, you know, you're good.
sentences.zh: 然后所有的评论家和所有人都会说，噢，你知道，你很棒。

sentences.en: Whereas if you just shoot intuitively, like Harold Ramis, you know, is a great director.
sentences.zh: 而如果你只是凭直觉拍摄，比如哈罗德·雷米斯，你知道，他是一位伟大的导演。

sentences.en: He directed a lot for us, but, you know, his movies are classics.
